tokyo-to-sapporo.approx_cost: Haneda→New Chitose flight about 1 h 35–1 h 40 (JAL, ANA, Skymark, AIRDO, StarFlyer); fares vary by date (JAL from ¥12,920 one-way shown for 29 Nov 2026; lowest seen on tour.ne.jp ¥8,379). Then JR Rapid Airport New Chitose→Sapporo about 37 min, ¥1,230.
